problems.problem: Decide whether (a) $\mathbb Q[x]/(x^2-1)\simeq\mathbb Q[x]/(x^2-4)$; and (b) $\mathbb Q[x]/(x^2+1)\simeq\mathbb Q[x]/(x^2+2x+2)$, where $\mathbb Q[x]$ is the ring of polynomials with rational coefficients and $(f(x))$ denotes the ideal generated by $f(x)$.

Let $n\ge1$ and let $m_i$ be natural numbers with $m_i<p_{n-i}$ for $0\le i\le n-1$, where $p_k$ is the $k$th prime. Prove that if $\displaystyle\frac{m_0}{p_n}+\frac{m_1}{p_{n-1}}+\cdots+\frac{m_{n-1}}2$ is a natural number, then $m_0=\cdots=m_{n-1}=0$.
Let $P$ be a polynomial with $P^{(4)}(x)=x^6+x^2+1$. Prove that $P$ does not have ten distinct roots.
Prove that if $f:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ satisfies $f(x)\le x$ and $f(x+y)\le f(x)+f(y)$ for all real $x,y$, then $f(x)=x$ for every real $x$.
